★Request
Fade in (Ep 6 flashback: 041062006)
Costume: Casual Clothes
Display Machikane Tannhauser

Phew~, that feels great!
Even if the sand makes the soles of my feet feel a little grainy.

I told her I was fine, but Machikane Tannhauser kept bustling around
for a while. Just watching her made me feel like I was getting my energy back.

Wasshoi mambo, festival mambo~♪
Splish splash, sway away, festival mambo~~♪

As I listened to her words, I looked once more at the items in front of me.
They were a completely random assortment, but what mattered was the care she put into gathering them for me.

Eating shaved ice at the beach hut, building sandcastles on the beach—
Tonight's festival was just one more part of it.

We arrived at the summer festival grounds. Perhaps caught up in the lively atmosphere,
Machikane Tannhauser looked like she was having a blast.
Phew, thank goodness~. What a huge relief!
So, I decided to do what everyone always does for me!

Ah, plus there's the summer festival tonight. We gotta get
our training done while we can! Chop-chop!

Just as she said, I had seen it with my own eyes. How she was adored,
loved, and cheered on by the children and everyone in the shopping district.

Trainer, you always tell me I'm full of energy, but
that's only because I've received so much support and warmth from everyone—

(That's true. Trainer oversees my training every day,
helps me look for hermit crabs, and...)

Alright then~~... Let's play high-ground tag today!
Here we go! Hippity-hoppity, rock-paper-scissors shoot!
Gasp. Or did they fall asleep from being totally wiped out...?

That's right, you've worked so hard up till now.
I'm sure you'll pull something great! Good luck!

Ah, but wait, wait—do you like this selection?
Is there anything else you want? 'Cause I can sprint off and grab it in a flash!

Summer training camp with Machikane Tannhauser was going smoothly.
While training thoroughly, we were also enjoying summer in moderation.

Ehehe, just gotta swim a bit more—wait, no!
I have to get ready for the festival. Uh-oh, uh-oh!
It was the very same warm feeling she had received from all the people around her.

Mun, mu-mu-mu~~n...!! Gathering up all the warm and fuzzy vibes!!
Ener-ener-energized to the max~~~!!

Worked up a good sweat! I'd love to just splash straight into the sea~,
but that's for later! Off for one more run!

These? These are energy sources I gathered from everyone.
I wanted to help you get energized, Trainer!
(Could it be that without realizing it, I pushed them way too hard...?)

Nope, I'm still good to go~. Right now, I'm on a total roll!
Must be because the ocean is right nearby. Hehehe.
Really? Did you get your energy back...?
(Ah! Come to think of it—)

The other day, Turbo shared her ultra-rare crab gummy with me,
and Nature gave me the last piece of dried scallop trim.

Fufufu~, it's a chant my dad taught me.
Do you want to try doing it together, Trainer?
Mambo, mambo~w! Festival mambo~~♪

Everyone... thank you so much!
I'll do my absolute best! Ready, and... go!!

Um... Trainer, you were fast asleep, right?
Seeing that got me worried. I just wanted to cheer you up and energize you.
See, remember what I told you before?

...Mm-mun? Could you be sleeping?
What's up, I wonder? An afternoon nap?

(Alright, then I gotta get Trainer bursting with energy!
First off—!)

(...What should I do? What did everyone do for me again?
How do I usually get energized?)

Fortunately, there was no one in the training camp lodge lobby.
With nothing specific planned, I decided to take a nap on the sofa.

Fuku-chan-senpai prayed for my victory with agar jelly noodles,
and my little buddies and the shopping street folks gave me all their warmth.

In other words, I wanted to do the same for you, Trainer.
To help you get your energy back!
Horyaaah, horyaaah, horyaaaaaaahhhhh!!
Ah! Trainer, good morning!

Phew~, what a splashy swim!
The ocean really is the best, huh?♪ So pretty and refreshing~.

Yo, Machi-nee! What are we playing today? Cops and robbers? High-ground tag?
I got way faster, so I'm down for anything!
Man~, I'm really, really glad to have everyone as my good friends.

I had only intended to take a short nap, but I ended up sleeping for quite a while.
Lifting my heavy body and opening my eyes—
Satisfied, satisfied, super satisfied~! Mmm-fufu~♪

What met my eyes was a mountain of assorted items piled on the table like an altar.
A whole grilled carrot, yakisoba pan, a cheering fan...

It seemed she received just as much affection from her family as she did from the people around her.
With her, I felt confident that fun-filled days would continue ahead.
You'll be fine! You've got this, Machi-chan. Go for it!

(I get it...! Up until now, I've always been energized thanks to everyone!
Then maybe I can energize Trainer the exact same way!)

Mm~! Look at this crowd! All the bustling noise!
It really feels like a festival, doesn't it~♪

Training wrapped up, and after parting ways with Machikane Tannhauser,
I returned to the lodge. There was still plenty of time before the festival started.

Alrighty, outfit change done! Luggage is... probably okay!
And Trainer is—
